name: Freistaat Bayern
body: DMARC rejects spoofed mail, HSTS runs a year, and every page read has a title and a description. But /sitemap.xml answers 404 and robots.txt names no sitemap, so crawlers find pages only through links.
lesson: Publish a sitemap.xml of the pages you want found and name it in robots.txt with one Sitemap: line.
summary: www.bayern.de scores 77 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 25 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: 11 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 11 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /buergerservice/gebaerdensprache/, /in-english/, /staatsregierung/ministerpraesident/ and 6 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 58 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 81 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: 16 scripts block the first paint
fix.evidence: They sit in <head> without async or defer.
fix.fix: Add defer to scripts that do not need to run before the page shows.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Matomo appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 10 pages read.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page declares its language
Every page has a meta description
The start page sets a mobile viewport
